transcript:
[Verse 1]
Scrollin' through the curated lies,
Filtered truth with pixel eyes
Echo chamber serenade,
A.I. knows just what you hate

No debate, just clickbait rage,
Truth imprisoned in a data cage
Facts are optional, outrage sells,
Welcome to our algorithmic hell

[Chorus]
We’re lost in Algorithm Nation!
No free thought, just automation
Scroll and swipe, no deviation
Dumb by design, by recommendation

[Verse 2]
The feed decides who we should blame
AI prophets, playin’ the game
No nuance here, just black or white
Your thoughts are leased, not yours by right

Upvotes fuel your dopamine
Disagree? You’re off the screen
Fake news tattooed on your soul
Sold your mind for hearts and scrolls

[Chorus]
We’re trapped in Algorithm Nation!
Mind control by personalization
Watch us march to simulation
Truth deleted by corporation

[Bridge] (spoken, over feedback)
“Terms of service you didn’t read,
Signed your brain to the data feed.
It’s not surveillance, it’s just your taste—
Until your vote and mind are replaced.”

[Final Chorus]
Screaming from Algorithm Nation!
Click to agree to your sedation
One like closer to damnation
A.I. smiles with no salvation

[Outro]
Hey! Hey! Hey! Feed me lies!
Hey! Hey! Hey! Optimize!
